_comment: Settings for scripts/build_video.py. Loudness values are RMS in dBFS. Times are seconds. Outro 'at' times match the Quiz #8 ending slide: clip 0-4.7 s, score comment 4.8 s, 'Want to see more?' 8 s, 'One more quiz?' 14.5 s.

script.intro: Welcome to Just One More Quiz! This is {series} Quiz number {number}. {count} questions, ten seconds each. Keep track of your score!
script.rules: Drop your score in the comments below. Let's get started!
script.question: Question {n}. {question}

outro.text: And that's the end of the quiz! How did you go?
Drop your score in the comments below.
If you enjoyed it, give this video a like and hit subscribe so you never miss a quiz.
Want one more quiz? Check out one of our other videos!

buzzer._comment: Taken from Canva's countdown audio: the buzzer sounds as the timer hits 00:00 (10 s into each question page). Its onset is searched for between search_from and search_to and placed at 'at'.

checkpoint._comment: Score-check card after every 10th question (Giulia, 23 Nov 2026: 'I like the idea of a checkpoint hook ... implement this for all future quizzes'; the 23 Nov report saw most viewers leave between Q3 and Q10). A code-made card in the brand fonts over the previous answer's blurred frame, voiced in the same voice. The Canva master design is not touched. 'good' is about 75% of the questions so far.
checkpoint.headline: SCORE CHECK

10.text: 10 down! Quick score check: 8 or more and you're smashing it. The questions get trickier from here!

20.text: 20 done! 15 or more? You're in the top league. Keep going!

30.text: 30 down, 20 to go! 22 or more is brilliant. The hardest questions are coming up!

40.text: 40 done! Only 10 left, and these are the toughest. Stay for your final score!
